value.rationale: A structural theorem about degree-six splitting of hyperelliptic maps and the exact singular boundary among canonical cubic sections over F2. The explicit split fiber supports arithmetic point construction; the sharp five-section obstruction explains why all smooth genus-four curves have degree-six places, whereas mere rho is already implicit in a published census.
